title: Sales Intern
compensation_detail: Earn commission on every client you bring
short_description: Help SoftBridge Labs grow by connecting businesses with our software development and design services. Earn directly based on your results.
description: We're looking for a motivated Sales Intern to join our Growth team. Your primary role is to identify potential clients and bring them to SoftBridge Labs for our services — web development, Android development, app testing, logo design, and video editing. There's no fixed salary; you earn a competitive commission for every successful client conversion. This is a great opportunity to build real sales experience, grow your network, and earn on your own terms.
responsibilities: Identify and reach out to potential clients via LinkedIn, social media, and personal networks
Pitch SoftBridge Labs services to businesses and individuals
Follow up with leads and coordinate with our internal team
Maintain a simple log of outreach and conversions
Represent SoftBridge Labs professionally in all communications
requirements: Basic understanding of software/tech services is a plus
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
No prior experience required — just hustle and drive
perks: Flexible remote work — work from anywhere
Direct mentorship from the founding team
Opportunity to convert to a full-time role

title: Campus Ambassador
compensation_detail: Earn rewards, swag, and commissions for campus outreach
short_description: Be the face of SoftBridge Labs at your college. Spread the word, grow our community, and earn rewards for every student or client you bring on board.
description: We're looking for enthusiastic students to represent SoftBridge Labs at their colleges and universities. As a Campus Ambassador, you'll introduce fellow students to our apps, tools, and services — and help us build a strong community of young developers and creators. You'll earn rewards, recognition, and real-world experience in marketing and community building.
responsibilities: Promote SoftBridge Labs apps and services within your campus community
Organize or participate in tech events, workshops, and demos
Share SoftBridge Labs content on social media and college groups
Refer students and potential clients to our services
Provide feedback from your campus community to our team
Represent SoftBridge Labs at college fests and hackathons
requirements: Currently enrolled in a college or university
Active presence on social media and college networks
Passion for technology, software, and startups
Self-driven with the ability to work independently
perks: Official SoftBridge Labs Campus Ambassador certificate
Exclusive SoftBridge Labs swag and merchandise
Letter of recommendation from the founding team
Priority consideration for full-time roles after graduation
Access to internal tools and early product releases
